versions.content: {DRAFT} If the config parameter EthCtrlConfigSwBufferHandling is set to TRUE, then a SW buffer shall be provided with a size according to all config- ured EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue's. The size of each EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue shall be calculated in bytes by considering the following formula: size of one EthCtrlCon- figEgressQueue = EthCtrlConfigEgressQueueBufTotal * EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue- BufLenByte.
